sentences.en: TUTOR: Right, Sandra.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 好的，桑德拉。

sentences.en: You wanted to see me to get some feedback on your group's proposal.
sentences.zh: 你想见我，是为了获取你们小组提案的一些反馈。

sentences.en: The one you're submitting for the Geography Society field trip competition.
sentences.zh: 就是你们要提交给地理学会野外考察竞赛的那份提案。

sentences.en: I've had a look through your proposal and think it's a really good choice.
sentences.zh: 我已通读了你们的提案，认为这是个非常不错的选择。

sentences.en: In fact, only have a few things to say about it, but even in an outline document like this you really have to be careful to avoid typos and problems with layout in the proposal, and even in the contents page.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我只对它有几点意见；但即便像这样一份提纲性质的文件，你也必须格外注意避免拼写错误以及提案排版（甚至目录页）方面的问题。

sentences.en: So read it through carefully before submitting it, okay?
sentences.zh: 所以提交前请务必仔细通读一遍，好吗？

sentences.en: SANDRA: Will do.
sentences.zh: SANDRA: 好的，我会照做的。

sentences.en: TUTOR: And I've made a few notes on the proposal about things which could have been better sequenced.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 我还在提案上做了一些批注，指出其中某些内容的顺序可以进一步优化。

sentences.en: SANDRA: Okay.
sentences.zh: SANDRA: 好的。

sentences.en: TUTOR: As for the writing itself, I've annotated the proposal as and where I thought it could be improved.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 至于文字本身，我在认为需要改进的地方都做了相应标注。

sentences.en: Generally speaking, I feel you've often used complex structures and long sentences for the sake of it and as a consequence headings help although your paragraphing and inclusion of sub- it's quite hard to follow your train of thought at times.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，我觉得你们常常为了追求复杂而刻意使用复杂的句式和长句，结果反而导致思路有时难以跟上；尽管你们用了标题，段落划分和子标题也尚可，但阅读起来仍较吃力。

sentences.en: So cut them down a bit, can you?
sentences.zh: 所以，请适当精简一下，可以吗？

sentences.en: SANDRA: Really?
sentences.zh: SANDRA: 真的吗？

sentences.en: TUTOR: Yes.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 是的。

sentences.en: And don't forget simple formatting like numbering.
sentences.zh: 另外，别忘了采用一些简单的格式规范，比如编号。

sentences.en: SANDRA: Didn't I use page numbers?
sentences.zh: SANDRA: 我没用页码吗？

sentences.en: TUTOR: I didn't mean that.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 我不是指这个。

sentences.en: Look, you've remembered to include headers and footers, which is good, but listing ideas clearly is important.
sentences.zh: 你看，你记得添加页眉和页脚，这点很好；但清晰地罗列观点同样重要。

sentences.en: Number them or use bullet points, which is even clearer.
sentences.zh: 请为要点编号，或使用项目符号——后者更清晰明了。

sentences.en: Then you'll focus the reader on your main points.
sentences.zh: 这样就能引导读者聚焦于你的核心论点。

sentences.en: I thought your suggestion to go to the Navajo Tribal Park was a very good idea.
sentences.zh: 我认为你们提议前往纳瓦霍部落公园的建议非常好。

sentences.en: SANDRA: I've always wanted to go there.
sentences.zh: SANDRA: 我一直想去那里。

sentences.en: My father was a great fan of cowboy films and the Wild West so I was subjected to seeing all the epics, many of which were shot there.
sentences.zh: 我父亲特别喜欢西部牛仔电影和狂野西部题材，所以我从小就被迫看了所有那些史诗大片，其中许多正是在那里取景拍摄的。

sentences.en: As a consequence, it feels very familiar to me and it's awesome both geographically and visually, so it's somewhere I've always wanted to visit.
sentences.zh: 因此，那里对我来说感觉非常熟悉，而且无论从地理特征还是视觉景观来看都令人震撼，一直是我梦寐以求的旅行目的地。

sentences.en: The subsequent research I did and the online photographs made me even keener.
sentences.zh: 之后我做的相关研究以及网上看到的照片，更让我心驰神往。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Interesting.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 很有意思。

sentences.en: Right, let's look at the content of your proposal now.
sentences.zh: 好，现在我们来看看你们提案的具体内容。

sentences.en: SANDRA: Did you find it comprehensive enough?
sentences.zh: SANDRA: 您觉得内容足够全面吗？

sentences.en: www.TopSage.com Test 7 73-09
sentences.zh: www.TopSage.com 测试7 73-09

sentences.en: TUTOR: Well, yes and no.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 嗯，既算全面，又不算全面。

sentences.en: You've listed several different topics on your page, but I'm not sure they're all relevant.
sentences.zh: 你们在页面上列出了多个不同主题，但我不能确定它们是否全都切题。

sentences.en: SANDRA: entertpSage.com No?
sentences.zh: SANDRA: entertpSage.com 不切题？

sentences.en: Well, I thought that from the perspective of a field trip, one thing needed to focus on was the sandstone plateaux and cliffs themselves.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得从野外考察的角度出发，必须重点关注砂岩高原与悬崖本身。

sentences.en: -27 The way they tower up from the flat landscape is just amazing.
sentences.zh: ——27 它们从平坦的地貌中拔地而起，景象实在令人惊叹。

sentences.en: The fact that the surrounding softer rocks were eroded by wind and rain, leaving these huge outcrops high above the plain.
sentences.zh: 周围较软的岩石经风蚀雨蚀后被剥蚀殆尽，唯独留下这些巨大的岩体高耸于平原之上。

sentences.en: It's hardly surprising that tourists flock to see the area.
sentences.zh: 游客蜂拥而至参观该地区也就不足为奇了。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Well, yes, I'd agree with including those points . . .
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 嗯，是的，我同意将这些要点纳入其中……

sentences.en: SANDRA: And then the fact that it's been home to native American Navajos and all the social history that goes with that.
sentences.zh: SANDRA: 还有，那里一直是美洲原住民纳瓦霍人的家园，以及与之相关的全部社会历史。

sentences.en: The hardships they endured trying to save their territory from the invading settlers.
sentences.zh: 他们曾为保卫家园免遭入侵拓荒者侵占而历经重重艰辛。

sentences.en: Their culture is so rich - all those wonderful stories.
sentences.zh: 他们的文化如此丰富——那些精彩绝伦的故事。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Well, I agree it's interesting, but it's not immediately relevant to your proposal, Sandra, so at this stage, I suggest you focus on other considerations.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 嗯，我同意这很有趣，但与你的提案没有直接关联，桑德拉，因此现阶段我建议你把重点放在其他方面。

sentences.en: I think an indication of what the students on the trip could -27 actually do when they get there should be far more central, sO that certainly needs to be included and to be expanded upon.
sentences.zh: 我认为，应更为核心地说明参加旅行的学生抵达当地后实际能做些什么，这一点当然需要包含在内，并且要加以扩充。

sentences.en: And I'd like to -27 see something about the local wildlife, and vegetation too, not that imagine there's much to see.
sentences.zh: 另外，我也希望看到一些关于当地野生动物和植被的内容，尽管我猜想那里其实没多少可看的。

sentences.en: Presumably the tourist invasion hasn't helped.
sentences.zh: 想必游客的涌入并没有起到什么帮助作用。

sentences.en: SANDRA: Okay, I'll do some work on those two areas as well.
sentences.zh: SANDRA: 好的，我也会针对这两个方面做一些补充工作。

sentences.en: But you're right, there's not much apart from some very shallow-rooted species.
sentences.zh: 不过您说得对，除了几种根系非常浅的植物外，确实没多少别的东西。

sentences.en: Although it's cold and snowy there in the winter, the earth is baked so hard in the summer sun that rainwater can't penetrate.
sentences.zh: 虽然那里冬季寒冷多雪，但夏季阳光炙烤使土地变得异常坚硬，雨水根本无法渗透。

sentences.en: So it's a case of flood or drought, really.
sentences.zh: 因此，那里实际上只有洪水或干旱两种情况。

sentences.en: TUTOR: So, I understand.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 我明白了。

sentences.en: Now, before we look at everything in more detail, I've got a few factual questions for you.
sentences.zh: 现在，在我们更详细地审视所有内容之前，我有几个事实性问题要问你。

sentences.en: It would be a good idea to include the answers in your finished proposal, because they're missing from your draft.
sentences.zh: 将这些问题的答案纳入你最终完成的提案中会是个好主意，因为你的初稿里遗漏了这些内容。

sentences.en: SANDRA: Fine.
sentences.zh: SANDRA: 好的。

sentences.en: TUTOR: So, you mentioned the monoliths and the spires, which was good, but what area does the tribal park cover?
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 所以，你提到了那些石柱和尖塔，这点很好，但这个部落公园占地多少面积？

sentences.en: Do you know?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: SANDRA: 12,000 hectares, and the plain is at about 5,850 metres above sea level.
sentences.zh: SANDRA: 12,000公顷，而平原海拔约为5,850米。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Larger than expected.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 比预想的要大。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Where's the nearest accommodation?
sentences.zh: 最近的住宿地点在哪里？

sentences.en: That's a practical detail that you haven't included.
sentences.zh: 这是一个你尚未包含在内的实用细节。

sentences.en: Have you done any research on that?
sentences.zh: 你对此做过相关调研吗？

sentences.en: SANDRA: Yes.
sentences.zh: SANDRA: 做过了。

sentences.en: There's nowhere to stay in the park itself, but there's an old trading post called Goulding quite near.
sentences.zh: 公园内部没有任何住宿设施，但在附近有一处名为戈尔丁（Goulding）的老贸易站。

sentences.en: All kinds of tours start from Goulding, too.
sentences.zh: 各种各样的旅游团也都从戈尔丁出发。

sentences.en: TUTOR: What kind of tours?
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 什么样的旅游团？

sentences.en: SANDRA: Well, the most popular are in four-wheel drive jeeps- but I wouldn't recommend hiring those. think the best way to appreciate the area would be to hire horses instead and trek around on those.
sentences.zh: SANDRA: 嗯，最受欢迎的是四轮驱动越野车团——但我并不推荐租用这类车辆。我认为欣赏该地区最好的方式是租用马匹，骑马徒步游览。

sentences.en: Biking is not allowed and it's impossible to drive around the area in private vehicles.
sentences.zh: 自行车游览不被允许，私人车辆也无法在该区域行驶。

sentences.en: The tracks are too rough.
sentences.zh: 道路太过崎岖。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Okay, lastly, what else is worth visiting there?
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 好的，最后，那里还有什么值得参观的地方？

sentences.en: SANDRA: There are several caves, but I haven't looked into any details.
sentences.zh: SANDRA: 还有几处洞穴，但我尚未深入了解具体细节。

sentences.en: I'll find out about them.
sentences.zh: 我会去查清楚这些洞穴的情况。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Okay, good.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 好的，很好。

sentences.en: Now what I'd like to know IS . . .
sentences.zh: 现在我想了解的是……

sentences.zh: www.TopSage.com 录音原文 +
